_comment: Shared safety-net corpus. Both ml/safety_net.py and server/services/safetyNet.js are checked against this same list by tests/test_safety_net_parity.py, so the two implementations cannot silently drift apart. 'critical' MUST trigger the override; 'non_critical' MUST NOT.
